verses.he: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הַטֵּֽה־יְהוָ֣ה אָזְנְךָ֣ עֲנֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־עָנִ֖י וְאֶבְיֹ֣ון אָֽנִי׃
verses.ar: صَلَاةٌ لِدَاوُدَ أَمِلْ يَارَبُّ أُذُنَكَ. ٱسْتَجِبْ لِي، لِأَنِّي مِسْكِينٌ وَبَائِسٌ أَنَا.
verses.en: A Prayer of David. Incline Thine ear, O LORD, and answer me; for I am poor and needy.
verses.kjv: A Prayer of David. Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I [am] poor and needy.
verses.web: A Prayer by David. Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

verses.he: שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁי֮ כִּֽי־חָסִ֪יד אָ֥נִי הֹושַׁ֣ע עַ֭בְדְּךָ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֑י הַבֹּוטֵ֥חַ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: ٱحْفَظْ نَفْسِي لِأَنِّي تَقِيٌّ. يَا إِلَهِي، خَلِّصْ أَنْتَ عَبْدَكَ ٱلْمُتَّكِلَ عَلَيْكَ.
verses.en: Keep my soul, for I am godly; O Thou my God, save Thy servant that trusteth in Thee.
verses.kjv: Preserve my soul; for I [am] holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
verses.web: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

verses.he: חָנֵּ֥נִי אֲדֹנָ֑י כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֶ֝קְרָ֗א כָּל־הַיֹּֽום׃
verses.ar: ٱرْحَمْنِي يَارَبُّ، لِأَنَّنِي إِلَيْكَ أَصْرُخُ ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ.
verses.en: Be gracious unto me, O Lord; for unto Thee do I cry all the day.
verses.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
verses.web: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

verses.he: שַׂ֭מֵּחַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃
verses.ar: فَرِّحْ نَفْسَ عَبْدِكَ، لِأَنَّنِي إِلَيْكَ يَارَبُّ أَرْفَعُ نَفْسِي.
verses.en: Rejoice the soul of Thy servant; for unto Thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.kjv: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
verses.web: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

verses.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי טֹ֣וב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב־חֶ֝֗סֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ صَالِحٌ وَغَفُورٌ، وَكَثِيرُ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ لِكُلِّ ٱلدَّاعِينَ إِلَيْكَ.
verses.en: For Thou, Lord, art good, and ready to pardon, and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon Thee.
verses.kjv: For thou, Lord, [art] good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
verses.web: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

verses.he: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה יְ֭הוָה תְּפִלָּתִ֑י וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבָה בְּקֹ֣ול תַּחֲנוּנֹותָֽי׃
verses.ar: اِصْغَ يَارَبُّ إِلَى صَلَاتِي، وَأَنْصِتْ إِلَى صَوْتِ تَضَرُّعَاتِي.
verses.en: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend unto the voice of my supplications.
verses.kjv: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.web: Hear, Yahweh, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

verses.ar: فِي يَوْمِ ضِيْقِي أَدْعُوكَ، لِأَنَّكَ تَسْتَجِيبُ لِي.
verses.en: In the day of my trouble I call upon Thee; for Thou wilt answer me.
verses.kjv: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
verses.web: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

verses.ar: لَا مِثْلَ لَكَ بَيْنَ ٱلْآلِهَةِ يَارَبُّ، وَلَا مِثْلَ أَعْمَالِكَ.
verses.en: There is none like unto Thee among the gods, O Lord, and there are no works like Thine.
verses.kjv: Among the gods [there is] none like unto thee, O Lord; neither [are there any works] like unto thy works.
verses.web: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

verses.he: כָּל־גֹּויִ֤ם ׀ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ יָבֹ֤ואוּ ׀ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֲדֹנָ֑י וִֽיכַבְּד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: كُلُّ ٱلْأُمَمِ ٱلَّذِينَ صَنَعْتَهُمْ يَأْتُونَ وَيَسْجُدُونَ أَمَامَكَ يَارَبُّ، وَيُمَجِّدُونَ ٱسْمَكَ.
verses.en: All nations whom Thou hast made shall come and prostrate themselves before Thee, O Lord; and they shall glorify Thy name.
verses.kjv: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
verses.web: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

verses.he: כִּֽי־גָדֹ֣ול אַ֭תָּה וְעֹשֵׂ֣ה נִפְלָאֹ֑ות אַתָּ֖ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ عَظِيمٌ أَنْتَ وَصَانِعٌ عَجَائِبَ. أَنْتَ ٱللهُ وَحْدَكَ.
verses.en: For Thou art great, and doest wondrous things; Thou art God alone.
verses.kjv: For thou [art] great, and doest wondrous things: thou [art] God alone.
verses.web: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

verses.he: הֹ֘ורֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה ׀ דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ אֲהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ יַחֵ֥ד לְ֝בָבִ֗י לְיִרְאָ֥ה שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: عَلِّمْنِي يَارَبُّ طَرِيقَكَ. أَسْلُكْ فِي حَقِّكَ. وَحِّدْ قَلْبِي لِخَوْفِ ٱسْمِكَ.
verses.en: Teach me, O LORD, Thy way, that I may walk in Thy truth; make one my heart to fear Thy name.
verses.kjv: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
verses.web: Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

verses.he: אֹודְךָ֤ ׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּכָל־לְבָבִ֑י וַאֲכַבְּדָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעֹולָֽם׃
verses.ar: أَحْمَدُكَ يَارَبُّ إِلَهِي مِنْ كُلِّ قَلْبِي، وَأُمَجِّدُ ٱسْمَكَ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ.
verses.en: I will thank Thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; and I will glorify Thy name for evermore.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
verses.web: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

verses.he: כִּֽי־חַ֭סְדְּךָ גָּדֹ֣ול עָלָ֑י וְהִצַּ֥לְתָּ נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מִשְּׁאֹ֥ול תַּחְתִּיּֽ͏ָה׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ رَحْمَتَكَ عَظِيمَةٌ نَحْوِي، وَقَدْ نَجَّيْتَ نَفْسِي مِنَ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ ٱلسُّفْلَى.
verses.en: For great is Thy mercy toward me; and Thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest nether-world.
verses.kjv: For great [is] thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
verses.web: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

verses.he: אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ זֵ֘דִ֤ים קָֽמוּ־עָלַ֗י וַעֲדַ֣ת עָ֭רִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א שָׂמ֣וּךָ לְנֶגְדָּֽם׃
verses.ar: اَللَّهُمَّ، ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُونَ قَدْ قَامُوا عَلَيَّ، وَجَمَاعَةُ ٱلْعُتَاةِ طَلَبُوا نَفْسِي، وَلَمْ يَجْعَلُوكَ أَمَامَهُمْ.
verses.en: O God, the proud are risen up against me, and the company of violent men have sought after my soul, and have not set Thee before them.
verses.kjv: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent [men] have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
verses.web: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

verses.he: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי אֵל־רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ فَإِلَهٌ رَحِيمٌ وَرَؤُوفٌ، طَوِيلُ ٱلرُّوحِ وَكَثِيرُ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَٱلْحَقِّ.
verses.en: But Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.kjv: But thou, O Lord, [art] a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.web: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

verses.he: פְּנֵ֥ה אֵלַ֗י וְחָ֫נֵּ֥נִי תְּנָֽה־עֻזְּךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝הֹושִׁ֗יעָה לְבֶן־אֲמָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: ٱلْتَفِتْ إِلَيَّ وَٱرْحَمْنِي. أَعْطِ عَبْدَكَ قُوَّتَكَ، وَخَلِّصِ ٱبْنَ أَمَتِكَ.
verses.en: O turn unto me, and be gracious unto me; give Thy strength unto Thy servant, and save the son of Thy handmaid.
verses.kjv: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
verses.web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

verses.he: עֲשֵֽׂה־עִמִּ֥י אֹ֗ות לְטֹ֫ובָ֥ה וְיִרְא֣וּ שֹׂנְאַ֣י וְיֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עֲזַרְתַּ֥נִי וְנִחַמְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.ar: ٱصْنَعْ مَعِي آيَةً لِلْخَيْرِ، فَيَرَى ذَلِكَ مُبْغِضِيَّ فَيَخْزَوْا، لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ أَعَنْتَنِي وَعَزَّيْتَنِي.
verses.en: Work in my behalf a sign for good; that they that hate me may see it, and be put to shame, because Thou, LORD, hast helped me, and comforted me.
verses.kjv: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see [it], and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
verses.web: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Yahweh, have helped me, and comforted me.
